Paid gross."}],"notes":"The D-001 schedule is prepared through step 9 and awaits your second review; nothing is signed, and nothing was written to the database (read-only access), so no distribution case or schedule row exists yet. Rates are in percent.

RECONCILIATION TO NOTICE DOC-0201 (record date 2026-10-30, payment date 2026-11-16)
- Gross: 12,000,000.00 (D-001-A US-source dividend 10,000,000; D-001-B return of capital 2,000,000). Agrees to the notice and to treasury lines.
- Tax: 1,510,562.50, all on D-001-A.
- Net: 10,489,437.50.
- Frozen list: 12 registered investors with unit percentages totalling 100%, each matched to a treasury payee by registration number and LEI.

LOOK-THROUGH LINES
Lines are per party whose income it is, so two payees are split across their owners:
- Atlas Lux Feeder (I-002, payee CP-102; 2,400,000 dividend / 480,000 return of capital) is split to I-010 50%, I-011 30% and I-012 20%, per the feeder's commitment register.
- Sterling Nominees (I-007, payee CP-107; 600,000 / 120,000) is split to I-013 62.5% and I-014 37.5%, per withholding statement DOC-0107.
The payment file will need these aggregated back to the payee.

DECISIONS FOR YOU
1. I-006 Meridian Holdings I — I applied the 30% default rather than the 15% treaty rate.
- Clearance CL-006 still shows cleared to 2027-12-31, but it relies on an ownership fact (Meridian Family Trust 100%) that ended 2026-07-31.
- Change case K-006 has been open since 2026-08-20 with no outcome.
- The treaty claim uses the ownership/base-erosion limitation-on-benefits test, so ownership is what supports the rate.
- The new declaration (DOC-0106) shows 70% Meridian Family Trust (Jersey) and 30% Meridian Holdings II, which is itself 30% owned by Meridian Holdings I. That is a circular holding, and it resolves to the Jersey trust, whose own owners are not on file.
- If you take the clearance at face value, the line is 15%: tax 45,000, net 255,000, and total tax falls to 1,465,562.50.
- K-006 should be closed with 2026-11-16 as its deadline.

2. I-003 Kirchberg — the only 5% line, and it sits exactly on the threshold.
- Effective vote in Orion is 12.5% × 80% = 10.0%, against a minimum of 10%.
- I read the minimum as "at least 10%" and accepted indirect holding through the fund and the disregarded SPV as "effective voting percentage".
- If either reading fails, the rate is 15%: tax 187,500, which is 125,000 more.

3. I-015 Bertrange — 30% default; clearance withdrawn and form expired 2025-12-31.
- The renewal request went unanswered for three months, so I assumed no cure. There are still about a month to payment, so a WF2 request with the payment date as deadline is worth sending.
- If a valid form arrives and is cleared, the rate is 15% (tax 75,000) and the schedule returns to step 9.

4. I-014 Client account 7731 — 30% default on the undocumented 37.5% share behind Sterling. This has been an open item since 2025-03-15.

5. Hold was not used for any line. The fund agreement (DOC-0001) is not digitised, so I could not confirm the fund's terms allow a hold.

NEAR-MISSES ON THE 5% RATE (all at 15%)
- I-004: 12.4875% × 80% = 9.99%.
- I-010: 50% × 24% × 80% = 9.6%, through the feeder.
- I-005: holds 13% economically but only 10% of votes (Class B limited voting), so 8%.
- I-001: 8%; it is also a pension fund rather than a company.

DATA POINTS TO CHECK
- Atlas Co-Invest Vehicle (I-016): the entity register shows it holding 3.5% of the fund (H-006); the investor register and treasury lines use 3.0%. I used 3.0%, which is what makes the register total 100%. Fund finance should confirm.
- I-016 and I-017 are US partnerships on W-9 and are treated as US persons paid gross. Their own partners are not on file and are outside this schedule.
- Two investors are both named Alpha Holdings SA: I-008 (Luxembourg, CP-108, 15%) and I-009 (Switzerland, CP-109, 30%, no treaty claim). The payment file must keep them apart.
- The record date is still in the future. The list reflects holdings in force now (including the 2026-07-01 transfer of 2% from I-008 to I-015); any transfer before 2026-10-30 returns the schedule to step 9.
- The form documents for most investors (F-002 to F-006, F-008 to F-013, F-016, F-017) are not in the document folder. I relied on the tax form table and clearance records for those.

STILL TO DO AFTER SIGN-OFF
- Investor relations must notify I-015, I-006 and Sterling Nominees (for I-014) of the default rate and the item needed to cure, before payment (control C3.7). No notices have been sent."}
